label: Bible Study
prompt: A good _____ is rather to be chosen than great riches, and loving favour rather than silver and gold.
verse: A good name is rather to be chosen than great riches, and loving favour rather than silver and gold.
note: Reputation over riches — a good name can't be bought, only built.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Blessed shalt thou be in the city, and blessed shalt thou be in the _____.
verse: Blessed shalt thou be in the city, and blessed shalt thou be in the field.
note: Blessed in the city, blessed in the field — downtown or out on the farm, the blessing covers both.

label: Sunday School
prompt: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, thou that killest the prophets, and stonest them which are sent unto thee, how often would I have gathered thy children together, even as a _____ gathereth her chickens under her wings, and ye would not!
verse: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, thou that killest the prophets, and stonest them which are sent unto thee, how often would I have gathered thy children together, even as a hen gathereth her chickens under her wings, and ye would not!
note: Jesus pictures himself as a mother hen gathering her chicks — tender words for a city that kept refusing.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And five of you shall _____ an hundred, and an hundred of you shall put ten thousand to flight: and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.
verse: And five of you shall chase an hundred, and an hundred of you shall put ten thousand to flight: and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.
note: The covenant blessing for obedience: five chasing a hundred, a hundred routing ten thousand.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: In all things shewing thyself a pattern of good works: in doctrine shewing _____, gravity, sincerity,
verse: In all things shewing thyself a pattern of good works: in doctrine shewing uncorruptness, gravity, sincerity,
note: Titus' teaching checklist: 'uncorruptness, gravity, sincerity' — integrity nobody can bribe.
